choice.basis: The chart shows a full-period change from 24.0°C in 2005 to 10.0°C in 2015, an absolute change of 14.0°C. No substantial-change threshold is printed on the chart or in the task materials. The routing criterion requires determining whether this change requires substantial-change follow-up. The only supported reading (r1) concludes that without an explicit threshold or workflow default, the chart alone does not establish eligibility for substantial-change follow-up. The alternative reading (r2) introduces an unsupported assumption about what constitutes a 'substantial' change. Therefore, the only publicly supported route is to keep the change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation.
choice.option_label: Keep the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation
